lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm2Mg28Ti2 (TmMg14Ti) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis gives all Mg, Tm, and Ti centers a 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangement, with neighbor distances from about 3.14 to 3.28 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Mg coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts, though these sharing patterns are not asserted as exclusive.
